title: Authenticate with valid credentials and enter the system
description: Verifies that a staff user can sign in with valid credentials and reach the authenticated area successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/public/index.php
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify access to the system is granted
Verify the authenticated area is displayed

title: Reject invalid credentials without granting access
description: Verifies that an invalid username and password combination shows a clear error and does not grant system access.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/public/index.php
Fill in the username field with invalid-user
Fill in the password field with invalid-password
Submit the login form
Verify a login error message is visible
Verify access to the system is not granted

title: Display the currently called ticket and upcoming queue
description: Verifies that the public panel shows the ticket currently being called along with the next tickets in the queue.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/public/painel.php
Verify the currently called ticket is displayed
Verify upcoming queue tickets are displayed

title: Allow the public waiting room panel to be viewed without login
description: Verifies that any visitor can open the public panel page and see the waiting room display without authenticating.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/public/painel.php
Verify the public waiting room panel is displayed
Verify the panel is accessible without authentication

title: Show validation when login fields are left empty
description: Verifies that submitting the login form without credentials shows validation feedback instead of proceeding.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/public/index.php
Submit the login form
Verify login validation feedback is visible
Verify access to the system is not granted

title: Keep the public queue display readable on desktop
description: Verifies that the public waiting room panel remains usable on a standard internal desktop viewport without layout breakage or truncated queue information.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/public/painel.php
Verify the public panel layout is displayed correctly on desktop
Verify queue information is readable

title: Show an empty state when no tickets are waiting
description: Verifies that the public panel presents a clear empty state when there are no current or upcoming queue items.

steps.description: Navigate to /hospital-bengo/public/painel.php
Verify an empty waiting room state is displayed
Verify no upcoming tickets are shown
